reviews.evidence: Own workflow spans daily discovery, review queues, curated scenario/category browsing, starter bundles, submissions, and machine-readable catalogs.

reviews.evidence: Five shipped tools cover web search, URL cleaning, capability discovery, vertical parameters, and 1–5-query batches; setup/config/E2E paths are concrete.
reviews.concern: No representative search or fetch result is shown; outputs are described only.

reviews.evidence: Shipped system covers self-evolution, multi-agent research, project oversight, natural-language control, device orchestration, collaboration, and extensions.
reviews.concern: Operational guidance ends at deployment; reliability evidence is mostly platform/config checks.

reviews.evidence: Three shared surfaces package workspace, terminal/browser/files, Git review, plugin market, skins, distribution variants, and vision; commands cover each.
reviews.concern: Only a few product workflows are demonstrated beyond launch and surface selection.

reviews.evidence: Interactive Web and optional desktop pets expose 15 event-driven states, growth/memory, live configuration, character switching, and presence handoff.
reviews.concern: Use cases remain centered on one companion scenario; desktop setup requires Rust.

reviews.evidence: Four subscription providers add OAuth/import, live catalogs, usage, effort/speed controls, media/X tools, multi-account pooling, proxying, and failover.

reviews.evidence: Search, page fetch, X search, six engines, key rotation and failover are paired with four worked prompts showing sourced outputs and a settings UI.

reviews.evidence: The site organizes broad AI guidance into browsable categories and provides local full-text search, dark mode, generated navigation, and a launch script.
reviews.concern: No explicit user scenario, search example, or concrete reliability evidence is demonstrated.

reviews.evidence: Event-driven desktop status, real todo progress, multi-session priority, interactions and settings are demonstrated across five states and a full lifecycle.

reviews.evidence: Authorized pentest sessions can record goals, facts, findings, assets and graph edges, render four Web views, and produce reproducible-step reports.
